quotes.text: During D209933 review, the author found that nsIMsgFolder.getStringProperty returned an empty string when a property did not exist, despite IDL text claiming it threw. The landed IDL corrects that contract, and EwsFolder.UpdateFolder explicitly checks for an empty ewsId before making a network request. The code still tolerates an empty sync state token for initial sync. When calling older XPCOM APIs, verify observable missing-value behavior instead of relying on stale interface comments.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.
